description:
Change a saved video, or ask about it (base_version from check_video). A change asked for in words costs 1 to 2 credits (dry_run: true says the price and sends nothing). It can: cut words or moments; change captions (size, place, font, one colour for all, on or off, all caps, and the key words' own colour on the styles that lay their lines out again); add titles and text, b-roll, and stock or web pictures and clips found for what is said; make motion graphics from a prompt (counters, lists, charts); add sound effects and transitions; set music on or off and its volume; warm, cool or brighten the look; hold the camera still; mute the camera's own sound over chosen seconds; add a new shape beside the video (16:9, 1:1, 4:5); switch the style (a new version, same cut); export and give a share link (if not exported yet it starts the export: ask again); cut a montage to the music; edit gameplay with a facecam. A question about the video ("is the title covering his face?") is answered from its real frames and changes nothing. Videos made from words: rewrite the script, change the narrator, add a voiceover, in any shape. Not by chat yet: speed changes, splitting or looping a video, copying a reference video's style (copy_style does that), finding clips in a long video (edit_video with clips does that). Say so; do not promise them; exact edits with the direct edit tools and fix_captions are free. Name output_id for one hook, Short or shape. Up to four still images can come with a change, each with intent: reference_only (look at it) or use_in_video (place it), as a ChatGPT file, an import_asset asset_staging_key or an owned asset_id. PNG, JPEG and WebP can be placed; a GIF is read by its first frame. A change that cannot be done comes back with the reason and the video is left as it was. To change the narrator, pass voice (a narrator name) with a change such as 'Change narrator to Brian. Keep the script and edit.' To add a voiceover, leave voice out and start change with 'Narrator: liam
Narration: <the exact one-line script>
<anything else to change>'. Keep the same operation_id and arguments on a retry; use a new operation_id for a new change. The change runs in the background: this answers at once with a job_id. check_video with that job_id shows the steps, then the editor's reply and anything it could not do.

dry_run.description: true: say what the change uses and send nothing.

operation_id.description: A stable ID for this authorized request. Preserve it on retries. Use a new ID only for a deliberate new request.

output_id.description: Change only this output (a hook, a Short or a format) from check_video.

voice.description: The narrator for a video made from words: matilda, sarah, jessica, alice, liam, chris, brian, george, roger, laura, charlie, river, will, eric, bella, daniel, lily, bill, adam, callum, harry (sarah: calm, reassuring, health and money; alice: a clear British educator; brian: deep documentary; liam: energetic ads). Leave out to let Clypmint pick one that fits the words. "Voice: <name>" in instructions does the same.

name: revise_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint revise_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.
